author: Combofied
body:
Combofied.

I was banned for combat logging.

I know its a temp ban but I Love the server and I was afk and then also I had no clue about the fact there was a combat log ban thing.

If I knew I woudve waited till I was not in combat and then left but instead I just left the room and was banned.

Hello,

It seems strange that you would have been banned for Combat Logging whilst your AFK. For that reason, I am not entirely sure whether it's true or not. Your ban will remain on your infractions page for now. Welcome back to the server, and please don't combat log again.

Regards,
